template_data.lead_html: SAM.gov doesn't send a goodbye email when your registration expires.

rows.what_html: GSA Schedule approved — positioned, relationship built, ready to bid
Registration lapses silently — no alert, no email, no warning from SAM
RFQ surfaces. Can't bid. — one missed date froze everything they'd built

template_data.closer: THE DOOR LOCKED WHILE THEY WEREN'T LOOKING.
